a common word written as a word (template text, a CI job name) is prose: counted once with the search that lists it, never listed as a place a rename breaks
want: written as a plain word outside the source:
name "note" with no call, quote or qualifier around it

--page all lists the prose lines too, marked, so the answer stays complete
--json keeps every row and flags the prose ones
control: a name that is not a plain word (make_note) keeps every text row, prose or not
control: a qualified mention of a common word (Journal.entry in a settings file) stays a binding, while the bare word in template prose does not
